analogy.rationale: Vitamin K antagonists act primarily on VKORC1 in the liver, and most of the annotated targets (carbonic anhydrases, CYP2A6) are off-target binding proteins with little transcriptional consequence in these cell lines; the closest reference classes are those sharing carbonic anhydrase or cytochrome P450 binding, while sterol/lipid synthesis inhibitors share the VKORC1-related vitamin K cycle/lipid pathway only weakly.
